notes: Controlling Commonwealth sources. Re-verify current compilations and Coal LSL operational guidance at use time.

sources.title: Coal Mining Industry (Long Service Leave) Administration Act 1992
sources.fact: Employee coverage and reimbursement authority come from the current Act, with disputed conclusions retained for human review.

sources.title: Coal Mining Industry (Long Service Leave) Payroll Levy Regulations 2018
sources.fact: The current levy percentage must be read from the in-force compilation each time, not copied from this index.

sources.title: Determining eligible wages, issued 21 June 2024
sources.fact: Non-casual Formula B includes overtime, penalties and non-reimbursement allowances before applying 75%. Category-specific salary and casual methods and insurer-payment distinctions must be preserved; the casual method changed on 1 January 2024.

sources.title: Coal LSL Levy Advice quick guide, pages 5, 6, 8 and 9
sources.fact: The reviewed guide retains exiting employees in Employee Details and preserves relevant weekly hours. Casual no-work weeks and part-time unpaid-leave weeks use zero; part-time annual leave retains normal hours. Recheck the form version at use time.
